V: "ask you."', 'a. G again erroneously reads "brother."'). expected_count=null: the lettered notes reset per verse-block and the strings reuse trivially across texts ('a. V: …' recurs), so no per-instance footnote string resolves uniquely and the total is not honestly countable by eye. Presence + per-text recurrence is the requirement, not an exact count.
